understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action, while walls can block movement and pushable blocks can be shifted when adjacent. Movement hints are heuristic, so blocked directions may still need testing. Multiple pieces can be controlled by CLICK using their pixel-coordinate positions, allowing each selectable to be positioned independently on a goal.
